data_platform.wizard_sync_leader_cursor: Change-tracking column (often updated_at) — only pull rows newer than your last run.
data_platform.wizard_sync_leader_incremental: Prefer incremental or CDC on large tables; reserve full refresh for small or slowly changing data.

data_platform.deploy_failed_desc: Something went wrong during the run. Fix the issue and try again.
data_platform.wizard_oltp_desc: Point this pipeline at a read replica when you can. Prefer Incremental with an updated_at (or similar) column so each run only pulls changed rows. After the first successful run, Ask, charts and SQL read the lakehouse — not this source.
data_platform.wizard_sync_full_refresh: Full refresh — reload the whole table
data_platform.wizard_sync_incremental: Incremental — new and changed rows only
data_platform.wizard_sync_cdc: CDC change stream — merge on primary key
data_platform.wizard_sync_cdc_hint: Needs a watermark column and primary key. Tags each change for Silver merge (not a database replication log).
data_platform.wizard_sync_log_cdc_hint: Events arrive from Debezium (or compatible forwarder) via the CDC inbox API — includes hard deletes.
data_platform.wizard_sync_log_cdc_setup: Run Debezium against Postgres logical replication, then POST change events to /api/pipelines/cdc/inbox (optional X-Aiser-Cdc-Token). Schedule ingest runs to land Bronze from the inbox.

data_platform.wizard_semantic_ssot_body: Ask, SQL, and dashboards read the semantic layer. This step publishes pipeline measures — the workbench is where you join tables (star/snowflake) and certify.

data_platform.wizard_sync_watermark_title: Incremental & CDC use a watermark column — not a replication log
data_platform.wizard_sync_watermark_desc: Each run pulls rows where the watermark is newer than the last successful sync. CDC additionally merges into Silver by primary key. Hard-deleted source rows are not tombstoned. Choose Full refresh if deletes must disappear from analytics, or the table is small enough to reload each time.

lakehouse_hub.overview_lede: Manage where lake files live, how SQL runs, and links to pipelines and governance.
lakehouse_hub.overview_analogy: Storage holds files; Compute runs SQL; Pipelines move data; Governance links access, certified metrics, lineage, and audit — without duplicating policy screens.
lakehouse_hub.pillar_storage_desc: Workspace and org S3 buckets, path layout, Iceberg warehouse roots.
lakehouse_hub.pillar_compute_desc: Query profiles with timeouts, concurrency, cache, and scan limits.
lakehouse_hub.pillar_movement_desc: Ingest, clean, and publish Bronze → Silver → Gold on a schedule.
lakehouse_hub.pillar_govern_desc: Row/column policies on sources, semantic metrics, catalog lineage.
lakehouse_hub.serve_desc: SQL editor, Ask, and dashboards use lake Gold through compute profiles and the same RLS as any data source.
lakehouse_hub.export_note: Gold pushed to a customer Postgres/MySQL/ClickHouse/SQL Server is a normal database connection in Data — not lake storage.
lakehouse_hub.storage_analogy_desc: Medallion files and Iceberg tables live here. Pipelines write; compute engines read. Configure once, then pick targets in each pipeline.

lakehouse_hub.storage_footer: Scheduled retention and compaction are configured per pipeline under Movement — access policies stay on each data source.

lakehouse_hub.storage_health_degraded: {count, plural, one {# storage target is unreachable} other {# storage targets are unreachable}}

lakehouse_hub.org_archive_class: S3 archive class (when disposition is Archive)
lakehouse_hub.org_archive_tag_only: Tag only (your bucket lifecycle moves tiers)
lakehouse_hub.org_openlineage: Allow OpenLineage export from pipeline detail
lakehouse_hub.gov_lede: Policies and definitions live on data sources, semantic layer, and settings — this tab links there and shows posture.
lakehouse_hub.gov_lede_desc: For banks and regulated teams: certify metrics in Semantic layer, enforce row/column rules on each data source, retain movement evidence on pipelines, and export audit and query history for regulators.
lakehouse_hub.gov_antipattern_desc: Row access belongs on each data source. Official report definitions belong in Semantic layer. This tab only links to those surfaces — it does not replace them.
lakehouse_hub.gov_retention_hint: Set a default Bronze retention under Storage to surface stale active Bronze loads here; per-pipeline overrides live on each pipeline’s Movement tab.
lakehouse_hub.gov_bank_desc: Aicser separates movement (pipelines), access (policies on sources), meaning (semantic certification), and evidence (audit logs). Pre-built regulatory report packs are not included — certified Gold metrics feed your reporting tools.
lakehouse_hub.gov_principle_access_val: Row/column policies on data sources; RBAC; SQL rewrite on every query (Ask, SQL editor, dashboards).
lakehouse_hub.gov_principle_meaning_val: Semantic layer certified metrics — not ad-hoc Ask KPI memory alone.
lakehouse_hub.gov_principle_lineage_val: Catalog + pipeline column lineage; OpenLineage export per pipeline when enabled.
lakehouse_hub.gov_principle_evidence_val: Org audit log, AI audit log (Govern SKU), lake query history.
lakehouse_hub.gov_doc_hint: Full mapping for risk and audit teams: server/docs/regulated-enterprise-governance.md
lakehouse_hub.gov_semantic_desc: Certify metrics and dimensions used in management and regulatory dashboards.
lakehouse_hub.gov_catalog_desc: Discover tables, profiles, and medallion lineage.
lakehouse_hub.gov_access_desc: Per-source row filters and column rules (masking, deny). Open a source → Policies.

workspace_storage.title: Workspace lake storage
workspace_storage.subtitle: Pipelines use built-in storage (the server's lake volume) until you set a bucket here.
workspace_storage.platform_managed: On hosted Aicser, lake storage is managed by the platform. To use your own bucket, connect it in a pipeline's Destination step.
workspace_storage.info: Built-in storage needs no setup and suits one server. Set an S3-compatible bucket for scale and backups: AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Google Cloud Storage (HMAC keys), Azure (S3 API), DigitalOcean Spaces. An organization can also connect its own bucket from a pipeline's Destination step.
workspace_storage.endpoint_help: Leave empty for AWS S3. Other providers need their endpoint, e.g. https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com.
workspace_storage.prefix_help: Where each organization's layers go inside the bucket. Must include '{org_id}' and '{layer}'. An organization can change it under Lakehouse → Storage.
workspace_storage.test_help: Writes, reads back and deletes a small file — what every pipeline sync needs.
